pattern_explanation: The Russian words in this card look similar to English words but have shifted in meaning, so the match depends on learning the Russian meanings directly.
false_friend_warning: The Russian word магазин, transliterated magazin, means shop or store, not magazine; актуальный means topical or current, not actual; and конкретный means specific, not concrete; learners who trust the similar spelling will choose the wrong English word.
